reported.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the lamp
reported.description: The loop reads D6 and calls toggleArmed() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 52-58) with no settle window, so each contact bounce is counted as a separate press. Measured evidence shows press at 2.00 s toggled D9 6 times and rapid presses toggled 3 times each, versus the required exactly one toggle per settled press. The 50 ms settle window required by the spec is never implemented, and the extra toggles at 2.50 s with no press confirm bounce edges are being acted on. 3 of 3 press(es) did not toggle D9 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [6, 6, 6]. D9 also toggled 15 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 2.50 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Shop estop pushbutton on D6 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); machine-armed indicator on D9.
- Each settled press toggles D9 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce bursts up to 22 ms must not produce more than one toggle per physical press.
- Use a 50 ms settle window before accepting a press.
- Print `shop armed=<0|1> presses=<n>` every 1200 ms.
- Unpressed idle level is HIGH on D6.
